$description: equipe design system — @generated by design/scripts/build.mjs from design/tokens/*.json; do not edit by hand. Change the tokens, then `npm run build`. Light is $value; dark is $extensions.mode.dark.

side.$description: sidebar — a step behind the page

side-hover.$description: sidebar row under the pointer — solid, so a title can fade into it

surface.$description: cards, sheets, fields (same as raised; desktop has no separate card fill)

sunken.$description: code, pressed wells, progress tracks (desktop code_bg)

popover.$description: what floats over the window: menus, popovers, the jump button

popover-hover.$description: a popover row under the pointer — solid, never see-through

prose.$description: reading text — replies, your messages: a shade softer than text

text-soft.$description: secondary text a step above muted (desktop text2)

muted.$description: secondary text — 4.5:1 on every surface, the selected sidebar row and popover included

on-accent.$description: text on a filled accent area

dot.$description: brand dot — logo graphic only, never text

border-strong.$description: field / control boundary that must be seen (3:1)

action.$description: filled primary action in product UI (text-colour fill)

hover.$description: neutral overlay: pointer over a row / ghost control

pressed.$description: neutral overlay: pressed — the hover wash doubled

inverse.$description: toast background (opposite of the page); tooltips use color.tooltip

tooltip.$description: tooltip chip — dark in either appearance

wait.$description: waiting for the person — their turn, approval

err-fill.$description: opaque fill behind err text — a soft destructive button; stays the same over translucent bars and scrolling content

err-fill-hover.$description: err-fill on hover — opaque, used instead of the hover overlay (an overlay drops err text below 4.5:1)

err-fill-pressed.$description: err-fill pressed — opaque, used instead of the pressed overlay

on-err.$description: text on a filled err area

member-0.$description: member / project colour — one lightness and chroma, so no member is louder

raw.$description: layer 1: raw values. Only semantic tokens reference these. The warm neutral and the hues are the desktop palette as shipped on main (crates/desktop/src/theme.rs, T-699); numbers are (1 − OKLCH L) × 1000.

warm.$description: one warm neutral (the brand Bone) — every grey on screen

500.$description: the brand dot (graphic only, not text)

600.$description: dark switch on — deep enough for a light knob

member.$description: member and project colours: 300 = dark (OKLCH 0.80 0.11), 700 = light (OKLCH 0.49 0.12)

space.$description: 4px base. 1-6 are for components; 7-9 are page rhythm (web sections).

sheet.$description: modal dialogs; mobile bottom-sheet top corners

sans.$description: Web only. Apps use the platform font (SF Pro / Roboto) — guideline §3.2. Latin in Inter; a page in no one language gives each CJK script its own face (Hangul Pretendard, kana Noto Sans JP, Han only Chinese writes Noto Sans SC). A page that says its language (<html lang>) takes that script's stack from $extensions["im.equipe"].lang, as :lang() in tokens.css.

float.$description: popover, menu, toast — desktop motion.rs float_shadow at full strength

overlay.$description: modal dialog, bottom sheet — NEW in v1 (no current equivalent)

type.$description: Type roles. $value = web (>640px). Overrides: web-narrow (<=640), desktop (GPUI), ios (Dynamic Type textStyle; size = Large default, reference only), android (Material3 slot, sp). Apps keep the platform font (guideline 3.2).

slow.$description: dialog, sheet, a card or message arriving

toast.$description: a toast without an action stays this long; pauses on hover/focus

reduced.$description: the only motion left under Reduce Motion: an opacity fade this short or shorter

standard.$description: the one curve: quick to start, soft to land

reduced.$description: under Reduce Motion every travel is 0

max-width.$description: dialog width on web/desktop; bottom sheet is full width

sidebar.$description: desktop sidebar (T-699). Rows are solid fills, not overlays, so a title can fade into them.

fg.$description: a row that is not open (desktop text2)

popover.$description: menus, popovers, the jump button (T-699). Solid in every state — a floating control is never see-through.

tooltip.$description: a small dark chip in either appearance (T-699)

secondary-fg.$description: a key hint inside the tooltip

switch.$description: on/off switch (T-699). The off track is below 3:1 on a card — see docs/t699-palette-map.md.
